name: Great Plains Grassland Fund
summary: Funds nonprofits and other eligible organisations to permanently protect high-value native grasslands in the Great Plains through conservation easements and related land protection, alongside community-led grazing and management models.
reporting: Applicants pick the most relevant project metrics from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system for future reporting.

status.quote: The Great Plains Grassland Fund (GPGF) seeks proposals to help permanently protect intact grasslands

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date: January 27, 2027, 9:59 p.m. MT

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: This funding opportunity will support land conservation efforts on grass-dominated landscapes across the Great Plains.

access.quote: The Great Plains Grassland Fund (GPGF) seeks proposals to help permanently protect intact grasslands

co_finance_required.quote: All grant awards require a minimum 1:1 match of cash or contributed goods and services.

reporting.quote: the Great Plains Grassland Fund has a list of metrics in Easygrants for applicants to choose from for future reporting.
